summary: Clean greenfield com.botfunnel.api: domain/repository/service separation mirrors Bot/Project conventions; reuses Sha256Hex + SecureRandom + HexFormat idioms verbatim. Hash-only-at-rest, 256-bit entropy, lookup-by-hash, and on-demand-only constraints (Decision 8) all met. Cross-file signatures verified. No critical or major findings.

findings.finding: lastUsedAt is exposed as a settable field for the Task-7 filter, but no test pins its behavior: generate() sets lastUsedAt to null, and regenerate() should reset it. Not asserted.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an assertion in generate_storesHashNotPlaintext (or a dedicated test) that stored.getLastUsedAt() is null after generate, and that regenerate over an existing key (with lastUsedAt previously stamped) resets it to null.

findings.finding: generate() resets lastUsedAt to null on every (re)generate via setLastUsedAt(null). Correct, but the WHY (a regenerated key starts unused; never carry over a previous key's lastUsedAt) is not commented.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a short comment explaining lastUsedAt is cleared so a regenerated key does not inherit the prior key's usage timestamp.

findings.finding: Project/Bot declare indexes via @CompoundIndexes class-level annotations; ApiKey uses field-level @Indexed(unique=true). Both are valid and auto-index-creation handles both, but the field-level form is a slight stylistic divergence from the two referenced entities (single-field unique indexes legitimately use @Indexed, so this is acceptable).
findings.suggested_fix: No change required; documented for transparency. Field-level @Indexed is the idiomatic choice for single-field unique indexes.

cross_file_checks.Sha256Hex.hex(String): verified — static, throws NPE on null; guarded at lookup boundary
cross_file_checks.SecureRandom + HexFormat.of().formatHex: verified — matches BotService.connectAfterPreChecks mechanics; 32-byte constant correctly NOT copied from WEBHOOK_SECRET_BYTES(16)
